facts.text: Jolene and her partner have been in a relationship for three years and are not married.

evidence.quote: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner met in an engineering class in college and became friends before developing a romantic relationship.

evidence.quote: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!

facts.text: Jolene and her partner enjoy working on engineering projects together and find it helpful for bonding and understanding each other's struggles.

evidence.quote: Teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner have a photo of themselves holding hands with rings on their hands, which they describe as a random photo.

evidence.quote: This is just our random photo.
